about_the_game:
Infiltrate the depths of cyberspace on a life-or-death mission to reclaim stolen valuables. Stealth around robotic guards, manipulate the surrounding environment, and retrieve your client's prized possession to ultimately escape the network. But once you snag it, the sinister bots will shotgun the self-destruction of their own network—all in an attempt to permanently wipe you from existence! Get in, get out, and take back what's NOT rightfully theirs.  

Features

  • Control a professional spy who's fast on their feet and adept with machinery! You can activate terminals to open and close walls, letting you push forward and stop guards from spotting or capturing you.

  • Find a possession at the end of the level, then traverse back through it in a different way! Use the very item you've retrieved by putting it on buttons that also open and close walls.

  • Avoid the robotic guards patrolling the area, or they'll give chase and try to capture you.

  • Be prepared to escape the network shutdown! After reclaiming the possession, an escape sequence triggers and demands that you escape before time's up. What's more, certain terminals deactivate, making escape even harder!

  • Each room has its own camera angle(s), allowing for simple yet effective observation of each challenge.

  • So far, one level can be played from start to finish.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: A sci-fi stealth game in which you must infiltrate digital facilities, steal back the possessions within, and escape without being seen. Along the way, you'll find switches that alter your path through the facility. Activate them on your own or with the stolen possession!
